$comment: The ONE place this plugin declares which madbench release its skill mirrors. No skill file restates the version; each references this file. Read by scripts/check-staleness.ts, which compares it against `madbench version` (advisory) and loads every bench under skills/madbench-evals/examples/ with the installed binary (the gate). Bump madbenchVersion and verifiedAt in the same edit, after re-verifying the versionSensitive files against the new release.
